final:
以下是基于官方材料对微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部的逐项分析。

---

## 1. 本季度收入同比增长了多少百分比？

**计算过程：**

- FY26 Q4（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）Intelligent Cloud 收入：**$39,306 百万**
  - 出处：`financial_statements.txt`，"Intelligent Cloud | Revenue | 39306 | | 29878"（Three Months Ended June 30, 2026）
- FY25 Q4（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日）Intelligent Cloud 收入：**$29,878 百万**
  - 出处同上行（Three Months Ended June 30, 2025）

同比增长率 = (39,306 − 29,878) / 29,878 = 9,428 / 29,878 ≈ **31.56%**，管理层四舍五入报告为 **32%**（报告口径）/ **31%**（恒定汇率口径）。

出处：`press_release.txt` 位置 3115："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"；`transcript.txt` 位置 24908："Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency."

---

## 2. 管理层在财报电话会上把增长归因于哪些因素？（引用原话）

管理层（Amy Hood 在 prepared remarks 中，`transcript.txt` 位置 25089–25121）列出了以下归因：

> **① 需求侧：**
> "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity."

> **② 效率提升（已发生）：**
> "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet** as well as **process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity**."

> **③ 产能变现：**
> "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was **quickly monetized**."

> **④ GitHub Copilot 消费超预期：**
> "Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption** following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."

> **⑤ 本地服务器业务的续约：**
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by **renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts**."

此外，Satya Nadella 在 Q&A 环节（`transcript.txt` 位置 40776）补充了效率相关细节：
> "efficiency gains in the CPU fleet … efficiency gains in the GPU fleet … process improvements we've made to make sure both CPUs and GPUs, just the lead time from how quickly we can get things to simplify it tremendously plugged in, was also improved over the past 90 days."

---

## 3. 归因中哪些是已发生的事实，哪些是前瞻性表述？逐条标注并说明依据

| # | 归因 | 性质 | 依据 |
|---|------|------|------|
| ① | "Customer demand **continues** to exceed available capacity" | **已发生的事实** | "continues" 是现在进行时，描述本季持续观察到的供需失衡状态，而非未来预期 |
| ②a | "efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" | **已发生的事实** | 用过去时 "was ahead of expectations driven by"，描述本季已实现的效率提升 |
| ②b | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" | **已发生的事实** | "improvements … was also improved over the past 90 days" — 已完成的流程改进 |
| ③ | "additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized" | **已发生的事实** | "was quickly monetized" 是过去被动语态，描述本季已经发生的变现 |
| ④ | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" | **已发生的事实** | "consumption" 是已产生的实际消费数据，"following the June business model change" 指已实施的价格模型变更 |
| ⑤ | "renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts" | **已发生的事实** | 描述本季已完成的续约交易及其会计处理结果 |
| — | "we **continue to expect** H1 growth to **accelerate**"（展望部分，`transcript.txt` 位置 33049） | **前瞻性表述** | "continue to expect" 明确指向未来；"accelerate" 是对 H1 FY27 增长趋势的预测 |
| — | "we **remain focused on delivering** efficiencies that help us **bridge the gaps** we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply"（`transcript.txt` 位置 33049） | **前瞻性表述** | "remain focused on delivering … help us bridge" 描述的是持续的努力方向和策略意图，而非已交付的结果 |
| — | FY27 Q1 Intelligent Cloud 指引：收入 $40.95–$41.25 亿，增长 33%–34%（`press_release.txt` 位置 30498 附近） | **前瞻性表述** | "we expect" 引导的对未来期间的明确预测 |

**区分依据总结：**
- **已发生的事实**：使用过去时态（"was"、"were"、"grew"、"driven by"）或描述本季已完成的实际结果（consumption、renewals、monetization），或用 "continues" 强调当前正在持续的状态。
- **前瞻性表述**：使用 "expect"、"remain focused on delivering … to"、"we continue to expect … to accelerate" 等措辞，指向未来期间（如下一季度、下一财年上半段），属于管理层指引或意图声明。
